topics.name: Data Ingestion and Transformation
topics.description: Performing data ingestion, transforming and processing data, orchestrating data pipelines, and applying programming concepts.

subtopics.name: Perform Data Ingestion
subtopics.description: Reading from streaming and batch sources.
keyPoints: Read from streaming sources: Kinesis, Amazon MSK, DynamoDB Streams, AWS DMS
Read from batch sources: Amazon S3, AWS Glue, Amazon EMR, Lambda, Amazon AppFlow
Set up schedulers (EventBridge, Airflow) and event triggers (S3 Event Notifications)
Handle throttling and rate limits (DynamoDB, RDS, Kinesis); manage fan-in and fan-out
Describe replayability and stateful vs stateless data transactions

subtopics.name: Transform and Process Data
keyPoints: Implement transformation with Amazon EMR, AWS Glue, Lambda, Amazon Redshift
Transform between formats (for example, CSV to Apache Parquet)
Connect to data sources via JDBC/ODBC and integrate multiple sources
Optimize container usage (EKS, ECS) and cost while processing data
Define volume, velocity, and variety of structured and unstructured data

subtopics.name: Orchestrate Data Pipelines
keyPoints: Use orchestration services: Lambda, EventBridge, Amazon MWAA, Step Functions, Glue workflows
Build pipelines for performance, availability, scalability, resiliency, and fault tolerance
Implement and maintain serverless workflows
Use notification services (SNS, SQS) to send alerts

subtopics.name: Apply Programming Concepts
subtopics.description: Code optimization, IaC, and best practices.
keyPoints: Optimize code and configure Lambda concurrency/performance for ingestion and transformation
Use IaC (CloudFormation, AWS CDK) and AWS SAM to deploy serverless data pipelines
Apply software engineering best practices: version control, testing, logging, monitoring
Describe CI/CD for data pipelines, distributed computing, and data structures/algorithms

topics.name: Data Store Management
topics.description: Choosing a data store, understanding data cataloging systems, managing the data lifecycle, and designing data models and schema evolution.

subtopics.name: Choose a Data Store
keyPoints: Choose storage for cost/performance: Redshift, EMR, Lake Formation, RDS, DynamoDB, Kinesis, MSK
Apply services to use cases (HNSW indexing on Aurora PostgreSQL, MemoryDB for key/value)
Use Redshift federated queries, materialized views, and Redshift Spectrum for remote access
Manage open table formats (Apache Iceberg) and describe vector index types (HNSW, IVF)

subtopics.name: Data Cataloging Systems
keyPoints: Build and reference a technical data catalog (AWS Glue Data Catalog, Apache Hive metastore)
Discover schemas and use AWS Glue crawlers to populate catalogs
Synchronize partitions with a data catalog
Create and manage business data catalogs (Amazon SageMaker Catalog)

subtopics.name: Manage the Lifecycle of Data
keyPoints: Load and unload data between Amazon S3 and Amazon Redshift
Manage S3 Lifecycle policies to change storage tier and expire data by age
Manage S3 versioning and DynamoDB TTL
Protect data with appropriate resiliency and availability

subtopics.name: Design Data Models and Schema Evolution
keyPoints: Design schemas for Redshift, DynamoDB, and Lake Formation
Perform schema conversion (AWS DMS Schema Conversion) and address changing data characteristics
Establish data lineage (SageMaker ML Lineage Tracking, SageMaker Catalog)
Best practices for indexing, partitioning, compression, and vectorization concepts

topics.name: Data Operations and Support
topics.description: Automating data processing, analyzing data, maintaining and monitoring data pipelines, and ensuring data quality.

subtopics.name: Automate Data Processing
subtopics.description: Orchestration and processing with AWS services.
keyPoints: Orchestrate pipelines with Amazon MWAA and Step Functions; troubleshoot managed workflows
Process data with Amazon EMR, Amazon Redshift, and AWS Glue; call SDKs from code
Prepare data for transformation (AWS Glue DataBrew) and query data (Amazon Athena)
Use Lambda to automate processing and manage events/schedulers (EventBridge)

subtopics.name: Analyze Data
keyPoints: Visualize data (AWS Glue DataBrew, Amazon QuickSight); verify and clean data
Use SQL in Amazon Redshift and Athena to query data or create views
Use Athena notebooks with Apache Spark to explore data
Describe tradeoffs between provisioned and serverless services; define aggregation, rolling average, grouping, pivoting

subtopics.name: Maintain and Monitor Data Pipelines
keyPoints: Extract logs for audits; deploy logging and monitoring for auditing and traceability
Use CloudWatch Logs to log application data and CloudTrail to track API calls
Troubleshoot performance issues and maintain pipelines (AWS Glue, Amazon EMR)
Analyze logs with Athena, EMR, OpenSearch Service, and CloudWatch Logs Insights

subtopics.name: Ensure Data Quality
keyPoints: Run data quality checks while processing (for example, checking for empty fields)
Define data quality rules and investigate data consistency (AWS Glue DataBrew)
Describe data sampling techniques
Implement data skew mechanisms

topics.name: Data Security and Governance
topics.description: Applying authentication and authorization mechanisms, ensuring data encryption and masking, preparing logs for audit, and understanding data privacy and governance.

subtopics.name: Authentication Mechanisms
keyPoints: Update VPC security groups; create and update IAM groups, roles, endpoints, and services
Create and rotate credentials (AWS Secrets Manager)
Set up IAM roles for access (Lambda, API Gateway, CLI, CloudFormation)
Apply IAM policies to roles, endpoints, and services (S3 Access Points, PrivateLink)

subtopics.name: Authorization Mechanisms
subtopics.description: Policies, Lake Formation, and least privilege.
keyPoints: Create custom IAM policies and store credentials (Secrets Manager, Parameter Store)
Provide database users/groups/roles access (for example, Amazon Redshift)
Manage permissions through AWS Lake Formation (Redshift, EMR, Athena, S3)
Apply role-based, tag-based, and attribute-based authorization; construct least-privilege policies

subtopics.name: Data Encryption and Masking
keyPoints: Apply data masking and anonymization per compliance laws or company policies
Use AWS KMS to encrypt/decrypt data and configure encryption across account boundaries
Enable encryption in transit or before transit for data

subtopics.name: Audit Logs and Data Privacy
keyPoints: Use CloudTrail (and CloudTrail Lake) to track API calls and CloudWatch Logs to store application logs
Analyze logs with Athena, CloudWatch Logs Insights, and OpenSearch Service
Grant permissions for data sharing (Amazon Redshift) and identify PII (Amazon Macie with Lake Formation)
Maintain data sovereignty, view config changes (AWS Config), and describe governance frameworks
